text:
alicia: quick nudge — final changelog sweep in 45m. If you have any one-line entries, drop them here or add to the keep-a-changelog PR. Please include component tag (eg. [runtime], [console]) and a 1-sentence outcome. I'll do the version bump after cutoff. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ben: example format?

alicia: example: `- [runtime] Reduce KV-cache memory by 10% (fixes OOM under heavy batching)` — component + short impact. If it's a docs-only change, mark `[docs]`.

ciara: adding mine now: `- [console] Show model-variant on route list (helps debugging mismatches)`

sam: do we bump minor or patch? My PR is a small telemetry tweak.

alicia: bump patch for telemetry tweaks unless there are API changes. I'll bump minor if >1 user-facing change. @deploy-bot will lock the branch at cutoff.

deploy-bot: RELEASE WINDOW: changelog cutoff in 00:30:00. Branch protection will enable merge block at 1959990300. :robot_face:

ben: ok here's mine: `- [serving] Improve batching scheduler fairness, reduces tail latency`

ciara: one more: `- [infra] Add prometheus alert for kv-cache eviction spikes`

alicia: please add `backport: yes` comment in PR if you need a backport. Also tag reviewers in keep-a-changelog PR. Thanks! :thumbsup:

sam: done, added my line and marked patch.

ben: I pushed to the changelog PR, left a short note about risk.

alicia: sweet — locking in 5m early to QA. If urgent, ping me directly.
